verdict.rationale: The axis applies, but the evidence shows Unreal does the opposite of a no-royalty license. Community reports say you must pay once a game earns more than $1,000,000 (unreal-comm-3), and one team estimated Unreal would have cost a $3M-budget game about $150k (unreal-comm-4). Source access is also EULA/account-gated rather than permissively licensed (unreal-probe-rt-1), and the license page only promises source access and all platforms and features, not royalty-free terms (unreal-docs-18).
